\section[(dialogue)]{Food and nature — a first pass}

\label{lesson:GU-R127-first-pass-food-and-nature}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a traveller and a hospital.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item a shore, a waterfall, a cave, a valley, a hill
  \item a desert, lightning, a storm, the earth, moonlight
  \item darkness, light, shade, a rabbit, a deer
  \item a bear, a jackal, a wolf, a pigeon, a duck
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
A shore? (\textbf{\gu{કિનારો}}.) A waterfall? (\textbf{\gu{ધોધ}}.) A cave? (\textbf{\gu{ગુફા}}.) A valley? (\textbf{\gu{ખીણ}}.) A hill? (\textbf{\gu{ટેકરી}}.) A desert? (\textbf{\gu{રણ}}.) Lightning? (\textbf{\gu{વીજળી}}.) A storm? (\textbf{\gu{તોફાન}}.) The earth? (\textbf{\gu{ધરતી}}.) Moonlight? (\textbf{\gu{ચાંદની}}.) Darkness? (\textbf{\gu{અંધારું}}.) Light? (\textbf{\gu{પ્રકાશ}}.) Shade? (\textbf{\gu{છાંયો}}.) A rabbit? (\textbf{\gu{સસલું}}.) A deer? (\textbf{\gu{હરણ}}.) A bear? (\textbf{\gu{રીંછ}}.) A jackal? (\textbf{\gu{શિયાળ}}.) A wolf? (\textbf{\gu{વરુ}}.) A pigeon? (\textbf{\gu{કબૂતર}}.) A duck? (\textbf{\gu{બતક}}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Nature and animals — a second pass}

  \item a butterfly, a squirrel, a hen, a cheek, a forehead
  \item an eyebrow, a beard, a moustache, a neck, a chest
  \item a back, a waist, an elbow, a palm, a fingernail
  \item a brain, a bicycle, a ship, a traveller, a hospital

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
A turtle? (\textbf{\gu{કાચબો}}.) A crocodile? (\textbf{\gu{મગર}}.) A mosquito? (\textbf{\gu{મચ્છર}}.) A fly? (\textbf{\gu{માખી}}.) A bee? (\textbf{\gu{મધમાખી}}.) A butterfly? (\textbf{\gu{પતંગિયું}}.) A squirrel? (\textbf{\gu{ખિસકોલી}}.) A hen? (\textbf{\gu{મરઘી}}.) A cheek? (\textbf{\gu{ગાલ}}.) A forehead? (\textbf{\gu{કપાળ}}.) An eyebrow? (\textbf{\gu{ભમર}}.) A beard? (\textbf{\gu{દાઢી}}.) A moustache? (\textbf{\gu{મૂછ}}.) A neck? (\textbf{\gu{ગરદન}}.) A chest? (\textbf{\gu{છાતી}}.) A back? (\textbf{\gu{પીઠ}}.) A waist? (\textbf{\gu{કમર}}.) An elbow? (\textbf{\gu{કોણી}}.) A palm? (\textbf{\gu{હથેળી}}.) A fingernail? (\textbf{\gu{નખ}}.) A brain? (\textbf{\gu{મગજ}}.) A bicycle? (\textbf{\gu{સાઈકલ}}.) A ship? (\textbf{\gu{વહાણ}}.) A traveller? (\textbf{\gu{મુસાફર}}.) A hospital? (\textbf{\gu{હોસ્પિટલ}}.)
